offering_description.value: Manages alternative investments for pension plans, insurers, endowments, foundations and private wealth investors. It builds and manages pooled funds and customized portfolios across private markets and hedge fund strategies.

primary_products.value: private equity funds; hedge fund portfolios; infrastructure funds; private credit funds; real estate funds

primary_services.value: alternative investment management; customized portfolio design and management; manager selection and due diligence

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporate pension plans, insurers, endowments, foundations and wealth management firms; B2G: public employee pension systems and sovereign wealth funds; B2C: eligible individual investors reached through wealth advisers

end_markets.value: retirement and pensions; insurance; endowments and foundations; sovereign investment; private wealth management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: fees for managing pooled funds and separate accounts, plus performance fees and carried interest

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: allocates client capital to external managers and direct investments through pooled funds and separate accounts

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: private equity, hedge fund strategies, infrastructure, private credit and real estate

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional relationships for fund commitments and separately managed accounts; partners / resellers: financial advisers and wealth management platforms serving eligible individual investors
